notes: A start read from the map's teleports; the finish is the bounds of the mapper's end triggers (chk-maps run 73). A race surf map: the spawn room is a lift (spawn_mover) whose exit is a teleport to the level1 destination, and every pit of level N sends back to levelN; the last ramp of level5 ends in two doors to winner_dest, the room holding end_trigger_ct / end_trigger_t; those start disabled behind team filters, so END is a box on their bounds. The start is a box from level1 down to the floor the player drops onto from it, and the spawn stands on that floor. The round's end_of_round_teleport volumes start disabled and cover whole levels (a winner enables them to send everyone else to the jail pads); dropped by round_teleports. Not published.
